pieces.title: New arrivals: the season's leathers
pieces.subtitle: Four new leathers, two new sizes, and the bags that arrived this month.
pieces.excerpt: The season opens with the Tabby in four new leathers. Everything here arrived this month.

pieces.title: Since 1941
pieces.subtitle: Six generations of leather craft, from a Manhattan loft to your shoulder.
pieces.excerpt: Coach began as a family-run workshop in a Manhattan loft, six leatherworkers making billfolds by hand. The glovetanned leather we still use was chosen because it wears in rather than out.

pieces.title: The Tabby Shop
pieces.subtitle: Our most-loved shoulder bag, reimagined in heritage leathers for the new season.
pieces.excerpt: The Tabby is the bag Coach is known for: a structured shoulder silhouette in glovetanned leather, with the turnlock that has closed our bags since 1941. This season it arrives in four new leathers and two new sizes.

pieces.title: The Tabby, returned to
pieces.subtitle: The silhouette you keep circling, and the pieces that finish it.
pieces.excerpt: Some bags are bought once. The Tabby is the one people come back for in a second colour, a second size, and then the crossbody strap that turns it into a different bag altogether.

pieces.title: Three ways to carry the Tabby
pieces.subtitle: Shoulder, crossbody, or in hand: the same bag, three days.
pieces.excerpt: The Tabby 26 comes with two straps for a reason. Short on the shoulder for the office, long and crossbody for the weekend, and by the top handle when the evening asks for it.

pieces.title: Pillow Tabby, up close
pieces.subtitle: Forty-eight seconds with the softest bag we make.
pieces.excerpt: The Pillow Tabby keeps the Tabby silhouette and swaps the structure for puffed nappa leather. Filmed in the workshop, unedited.

pieces.title: Date night, carried light
pieces.subtitle: A bag that holds a phone, a card and a lipstick, and nothing you will regret bringing.
pieces.excerpt: The evening bag question is always the same: how little can you carry and still feel prepared. Our answer is a small shoulder bag with a chain strap, in a leather that catches the light.

pieces.title: The Brooklyn, for the commute
pieces.subtitle: A slouchy shoulder bag that swallows a laptop and still looks like a bag.
pieces.excerpt: The Brooklyn is the tote for people who do not want to carry a tote. Soft, unlined, and shaped by what you put in it.

pieces.title: The work tote, packed properly
pieces.subtitle: What goes where, so the tote stays a tote.
pieces.excerpt: A tote fails when everything sinks to the bottom. The Mollie has a zip pocket for the things you reach for and a flat pocket for the things you do not, and the rest is up to you.

pieces.title: Travel light: the crossbody
pieces.subtitle: Hands free through the airport, the market and the museum.
pieces.excerpt: The crossbody is the travel bag because it never needs putting down. The Nolita and the Kira are the two we pack ourselves.

pieces.title: The Rogue, made to last
pieces.subtitle: Seventy-two seconds on the bag that is built, not assembled.
pieces.excerpt: The Rogue is cut from a single hide, hand-burnished at every edge, and finished with hardware that is cast rather than plated. The film shows why it costs what it costs.

pieces.title: Considered, not ordinary
pieces.subtitle: An elevated selection in our finest leathers, chosen for the discerning eye.
pieces.excerpt: Eight pieces from the top of the range, photographed in the light they were made for. Nothing here is on offer, and nothing here needs to be.

pieces.title: Gifts that cannot miss, under $200
pieces.subtitle: A card case, a charm, a wallet: the small things that get used every day.
pieces.excerpt: The safest gift is the one that gets used. Everything here is under two hundred dollars, monogrammable, and comes in the box.

pieces.title: Festival, hands free
pieces.subtitle: A crossbody in a colour that shows up in photographs.
pieces.excerpt: Three days outdoors need a bag that closes properly, sits close, and does not mind the dust. The quilted Tabby crossbody was made for exactly that weekend.

pieces.title: Winter wedding, in crystal
pieces.subtitle: The Tabby, embellished for the one night it matters.
pieces.excerpt: The crystal Tabby is the evening bag for a winter wedding: small enough for the table, bright enough for the photographs, and still a Tabby the next morning.

pieces.title: The Summer Edit
pieces.subtitle: Coral and natural straw, right for the season.
pieces.excerpt: Summer bags are lighter in every sense. This edit leads with coral leather and natural straw, in the shapes that travel well and dry fast.

pieces.title: The Winter Edit
pieces.subtitle: Burgundy and chocolate leather, for the darker months.
pieces.excerpt: Winter is when leather looks its best. The edit is burgundy, chocolate and black, in the structured shapes that hold up to a coat.

pieces.title: Gallery hours
pieces.subtitle: A small bag, an evening opening, and nothing to check at the door.
pieces.excerpt: The gallery bag is the one that does not compete with the room. Quiet leather, a chain that sits flat, and a size that never needs setting down.

pieces.title: Brunch, then everything after
pieces.subtitle: The bag that goes from the table to the whole day.
pieces.excerpt: A Sunday bag has to survive a plan that changes. Shoulder for the table, crossbody for the walk, and big enough for the thing you buy on the way home.

pieces.title: The Kisslock, five nights running
pieces.subtitle: Fifty-five seconds, one frame bag, five evenings.
pieces.excerpt: The Kisslock frame is the oldest closure we make and the most satisfying. We followed one bag through a week of evenings.

pieces.title: The hobo, relaxed
pieces.subtitle: Slouch on purpose: the Teri and the Hadley.
pieces.excerpt: The hobo is the bag that looks better the more it is used. Soft leather, one strap, and a shape that settles on the shoulder.

pieces.title: Coachtopia: crafted to last, designed to circle back
pieces.subtitle: Our circular sub-brand, made with recycled and repurposed leather.
pieces.excerpt: Coachtopia makes bags from the offcuts and the returns of the main line, designed from the start to be repaired, resold and remade.

pieces.title: Made personal
pieces.subtitle: Complimentary monogramming and lifetime craftsmanship care on every Coach piece.
pieces.excerpt: Every bag and every wallet can be monogrammed in store or at checkout, and every one is covered by craftsmanship care for as long as you own it.

pieces.title: How the Tabby is made
pieces.subtitle: Two minutes in the workshop, from hide to turnlock.
pieces.excerpt: Forty-one steps, most of them by hand. The film follows one Tabby from the cutting table to the final polish.

pieces.title: Leather care, properly
pieces.subtitle: What to do about rain, and what not to do about scuffs.
pieces.excerpt: Glovetanned leather wants very little: a dry cloth, occasional conditioner, and to be left alone about the marks that give it character.

pieces.title: This week's arrivals
pieces.subtitle: What landed in the last seven days.
pieces.excerpt: A short list, refreshed every Monday: the pieces that arrived this week, in the order they came in.
